notes:
Checked on 2026-10-09. Read the complete 74,227-character markdown conversion, including the references (18 printed PDF pages; no appendix follows the references). Cross-checked PDF text on pp. 1, 16 and 18, all PDF link annotations, and availability-related keywords across all 18 PDF pages. The PDF has no embedded files.

No statement promises data, code or research materials through a repository or on request. No preregistration, online appendix or supplementary-file reference was found. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are empty. Therefore statements and deposits are empty; unrelated bibliography links and search hits are not deposits for c176.

The article describes the TTCT instrument and its adaptation on p. 6, the training program on pp. 7-9 and the session summary in Table 2 (pp. 8-9). It mentions SPSS analyses (pp. 9-10) but supplies no syntax or code link. Tables 4-7 (pp. 10-13) contain aggregate statistics, not participant records or raw TTCT responses. The CC BY-NC 4.0 statement on p. 1 applies to the article and does not establish a dataset license.

The English title and first-author surname, broader English title terms, Arabic title terms, the Arabic surname and a first-name/surname conjunction were searched through the named public APIs. No matching deposit was identified. Successful repeated searches were consolidated by source and query; the two initial Zenodo HTTP 400 page-size errors are recorded separately. Counts are API-returned records, including version duplicates where present, not inferred dataset counts. OSF's specified title-filter endpoint cannot by itself provide a comprehensive author-contributor search.

The publisher supplementary-material check remains unresolved: https://dsr.ju.edu.jo/djournals/index.php/Edu/article/view/13368 and https://doi.org/10.35516/edu.2026.13368 both returned HTTP 200 with 'Request Rejected'. The DOI is the same as the capitalized https://doi.org/10.35516/Edu.2026.13368 printed in the PDF. No login, access request or block circumvention was attempted. Confidence is medium because no public deposit was found but publisher supplements could not be inspected; none_found is not proof that no deposit exists.

No public participant-level data, output records, assignment columns, score columns or texts were available to inspect. Nothing found resolves the final.open_items on analyzed counts/exclusions, test-time AI access, main-sample scoring protocol, or class-aware pairwise uncertainty. One class was assigned to each arm (S1; pp. 6 and 9); individual records alone would not supply replicated classes.

HTTP audit of other paper links follows. URLs broken by markdown line wrapping were recovered from PDF hyperlink targets or PDF text; no truncated URL fragments were treated as deposits. HTTP 200 on a challenge or redirect page does not establish access to that article. These links concern licensing, author identifiers or cited works, rather than c176 data.
